name: dsh-phone-bridge
description: Native DSH bridge plugin. Host half: a loopback TCP JSON-RPC bridge (127.0.0.1, random port, <DSH_HOME>/dsh-phone/bridge/endpoint.json) that is wire-compatible with the Agents Anywhere bridge, so the dsh-phone Rust node gets sessions, history, live sync, sending and interrupts without AA installed. Browser half: sniffs the desktop's own session/event traffic and pushes it to the node over HTTP (127.0.0.1:8460) via /api/bridge/ingest.
